repos_data.description: A lightning-fast search engine API bringing AI-powered hybrid search to your sites and applications.
Open Source AI Platform - AI Chat with advanced features that works with every LLM
Open Source alternative to Algolia + Pinecone and an Easier-to-Use alternative to ElasticSearch ⚡ 🔍 ✨ Fast, typo tolerant, in-memory fuzzy Search Engine for building delightful search experiences
Open-source, self-hosted enterprise & site search server built on OpenSearch. Crawls web / file / DB / cloud sources, 20+ languages, REST API, and AI/RAG & semantic search. Apache-2.0.

Open-source enterprise search + generative AI platform. Faceted semantic search, hybrid BM25+vector ranking, RAG chat with citations, AI agents and MCP tools — on Apache Solr, Elasticsearch or embedded Lucene. Indexes Adobe AEM, WordPress, databases and files via the Viglet Dumont connectors. Self-hosted Apache-2.0 alternative to Algolia and Coveo.
